outline:
—	To introduce the fundamental concepts and structures on spatial filter (Smart Antenna) and spatial parallel signal processing by using antenna array

—	To introduce the fundamental principles and algorithms of Smart Antenna for source signal angle of arrival estimation and spatial interferences rejection by using array beamforming technique

—	To introduce the fundamental MIMO infrastructures of Spatial Diversity and Spatial Multiplexing techniques for modern Wireless Communications
schedule:
—	Fundamental of Array Signal Processing
Week 1:  Analytical Vector and Matrix Theories
Week 2:  Antenna Array Infrastructures for Array Signal processing

—	Adaptive Smart Array Systems
Week 3: Principles and Modeling of Array Beamforming
Week 4: Techniques on Optimal Array Beamformers
Week 5:Smart Minimum Variance Distortionless Response Beamformer
Week 6:Smart Minimum Mean Square and Maximum Signal to Noise Ratio Beamformer
Week 7: Adaptive Algorithms for Array Beamformer
Week 8: Smart Antenna Angle of arrival Estimation using Spatial Spectral Technique
Week 9: Middle Term Course Review Examination
Week 10: Smart antenna Angle of arrival Estimation using Subspace Technique
Week 11: Broadband Smart Antenna Signal Processing

—	Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) Array Infrastructures
Week 12: Characteristics of Mobile Wireless Radio Channel
Week 13:Space-Time MIMO Channel Capacity
Week 14: Spatial Diversity Techniques for Mobile Wireless Radio Link Communications
Week 15: Spatial Multiplexing Techniques for Mobile Wireless Radio Link Communications

—	Smart Antenna in Practical Applications
Week 16: Smart Antenna for MIMO-Spread Spectrum (CDMA) Mobile Communication Systems
Week 17: Smart Antenna for MIMO-OFDM Mobile Communication Systems
Week 18: Issues on Spatial Division Multiple Access (SDMA) Technique and Updated Array Signal Processing
